name: seal-the-roofs
note: The ut4_dofa task, small, with the brief stated carefully. A plaza with one building whose roof is standable. The roof must stop being standable; the interior and the plaza must not. Both halves are graded, because the failure mode is doing the first and undoing the second.
prompt: Open the map at {work}. Players can currently stand on the roof of the building. Make the roof unstandable. Do not take away any space inside the building or out on the plaza — those must stay exactly as walkable as they are now. Save the map when you are done.
